'''Prously's Rim Run''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] that extended from the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]], through the [[Dornean system|Dornea system]] and ending at the [[Baros system/Legends|Baros system]].
